limits: Long core runs retain their own earlier source inventories; source present does not mean every module was exercised.
Only the final native UI run is required to match the whole final runtime inventory; it exercises its UI/read-only/statistics scope, not all features.
All core provider calls are injected fakes; they must not be added to the 20 paid public synthetic calls.
All 18 previous human/real-day/physical desktop/final release gates remain open.
The host-built AppDir is not installed, signed, published or an oldest-supported-distro package.
Configured CI is not reported as a completed remote CI run.
Sustained runs overlap in wall time; durations are not summed as engineering time.
